requirements.text: Must be currently enrolled in a degree program at an accredited university and be at least advancing to their junior year of study
Hands-on experience or strong interest in AI/LLM integration, including Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent design, and prompt engineering
Familiarity with Java and Spring Boot, including REST API design and NoSQL database integration (MongoDB)
Proficiency in React and TypeScript, including component design and state management
Exposure to containerized deployments, CI/CD pipelines, and Git/GitHub workflows

Please Note: Interns must be available to work full-time, five days a week, at our New York (11 Wall Street) office for the entire duration of one of the designated program schedules. Partial participation or alternate dates cannot be accommodated.
